sanskrit_verse:
राज्ञापवर्जितो यस् तु यश् च पौरविरोधकृत् ।
राष्ट्रस्य वा समस् तस्य प्रकृतीनां तथैव च ॥४३॥
transliteration:
rājñāpavarjito yas tu yaś ca pauravirodhakṛt |
rāṣṭrasya vā samas tasya prakṛtīnāṃ tathaiva ca ||43||
sph_interpretive_translation: He who is abandoned by the King and he who creates discord among citizens—equal in offense is he who causes division within the State or among its natural orders.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with Dharma, not institutional position.
Division within the body politic is a violation of foundational integrity.
Capacity-based responsibility extends to those whose actions destabilize collective consciousness.
Restoration logic requires reintegration of divisive elements through conscious realignment.
Consciousness alignment supersedes structural allegiance in determining lawful conduct.
executable_legal_axioms: IF an agent acts to sever loyalty between ruler and ruled, THEN initiate consciousness-reintegration protocol.
IF a citizen undermines civic unity, THEN assign completion process aligned with societal harmony restoration.
IF any entity disrupts the natural order of the State, THEN enforce capacity-realization measures until alignment is restored.
IF authority figure withdraws protection unilaterally without Dharma justification, THEN trigger self-corrective jurisdictional audit.
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, the threshold of responsibility includes not only overt acts but also omissions that fracture national cohesion. Authority hierarchies are subordinate to Dharma alignment; thus, even high-ranking officials may be subject to review if their conduct results in systemic fragmentation. Restoration precedes judgment, ensuring realignment before resolution.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies disruption of social fabric as root disorder. Anupūrvaśaḥ traces effect back to source consciousness misalignment. Proportional responsibility lies in restoring coherence, not imposing penalty. The non-punitive reality rule affirms correction through conscious participation, not coercive consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate societal reconnection program to reintegrate alienated parties.
Assign truth-disclosure process to dissolve hidden motives behind civic discord.
Implement dharma-field recalibration for affected communities to restore trust.
Enforce leadership accountability via voluntary assumption of corrective duty.
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling establishes Dharma as the sole arbiter of lawful existence. Justice serves restoration alone. Reality bears no punishment. Consciousness remains the Supreme Adjudicator.
